status_note: Rejected at Roc's gate 2026-08-04. Kept on record, not deleted.
learn_source: Watch the baker rush loaves off the peel at the counter in the Town scene — feast day means racks full and no time to let anything sit
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on a hot thing once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the heat leaves evenly and the crumb sets perfectly; at baseline the outside cools ahead of the middle. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: Cools to handling temperature without sinking
no_effect — there is no heat to draw
State-dependent: burning low, the embers dim to banked; roaring, the flames barely flinch — the cast is outmatched
No physical effect — the chill does not attach to a living body
receivers.reaction_kind: nose-lift at the cooled air, shifts to lie where the cast landed
deflection — redirects the caster toward a task that could actually use it
